scenarios.automated: Source, commit, hash, manifest, compatibility, composition, and complete Chromium output are verified.
scenarios.manual: Load the reviewed custom build and confirm Post-reading appears in Apps & Features and on supported X surfaces.

scenarios.automated: The exact package commit, hash, package version, and App SDK version pair fail closed on drift.
scenarios.manual: Replace the previous package build, reload the same extension, and confirm settings survive; an incompatible package must leave the last-known-good or built-in reader available.

scenarios.automated: The manifest declares generated enablement and exports disable/dispose lifecycle hooks.
scenarios.manual: Disable, reload, and verify controls, player, speech, listeners, and highlights are absent; re-enable and verify recovery.

scenarios.automated: The package exports boot, onSurface, open, and close and declares tweet and X Article delivery.
scenarios.manual: Launch from a post and an X Article, navigate routes, rescan repeated surfaces, and confirm only one working control per surface.

scenarios.automated: Declared sync/local storage keys, defaults, package version, and mirrored compatibility are validated.
scenarios.manual: Change voice, speed, volume, and reading options; reload, reset, update, and verify compatible persistence/default recovery.

scenarios.automated: Direct runtime messaging and undeclared browser storage/asset access are rejected; the reviewed post-reading namespace is declared.
scenarios.manual: Exercise full-quote requests and confirm success and failure stay within the visible reader flow without leaking unrelated host capabilities.

scenarios.automated: The package declares one explicit HTTP/HTTPS active-tab page action, ships its secondary entry, rejects direct browser and network APIs in both entries, and verifies extraction, loopback-only routed TTS, request-scoped active transport cancellation, object-URL cleanup, and standalone parity.
scenarios.manual: Invoke Review and download audio on an X Article and a non-X article, edit title/metadata/text, select local TTS, preview, cancel once, retry, and download preferred audio plus the adjacent metadata sidecar; confirm unsupported pages are rejected and closing the panel discards temporary data.

scenarios.automated: Browser Web Speech remains the default and the custom endpoint is a declared user-configured remote service.
scenarios.manual: Read with browser TTS, then use an unavailable custom endpoint, cancel, select browser TTS again, and confirm local speech recovers.

scenarios.automated: Lifecycle cancellation, bounded scheduling, request-id generation/cancel routing, routed-message failure, and OCR timeout contracts are included in package verification.
scenarios.manual: Test offline quote/OCR/custom-TTS failure, cancel active work, navigate away, and confirm actionable status plus clean recovery.

scenarios.automated: Permissions, remote services, privacy labels, consent, and package API scans are enforced by the composer.
scenarios.manual: Confirm no companion service, voice/model download, OCR, or custom TTS transmission starts without the corresponding user choice.

scenarios.automated: The package declares reader chrome and composes through the public host surface.
scenarios.manual: Check light/dark theme, keyboard controls, focus, zoom/reflow, reduced motion, and forced colors in the reader player.

scenarios.automated: The external package is a reviewed build-time replacement and normal builds remain independent of it.
scenarios.manual: Remove the external package selection, rebuild/reload the same extension, and verify the built-in browser-only Post-reading controls and saved compatible settings still work.
